title: ranunculus montanus subsp. gouanii
intro: Ranunculus montanus subsp. gouanii, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup, is a flowering plant species within the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as fever reduction, inflammation, and pain relief. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus montanus subsp. gouanii include its antipyretic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. While more research is needed, preliminary studies suggest that these bioactive compounds may contribute to the plant's potential therapeutic effects.
